name: Buf
summary: Protobuf modules on the Buf registry.
description: Buf's hosted server searches and reads Protobuf modules on the Buf Schema Registry.

probe.note: Answers an unauthenticated initialize with 401 and publishes OAuth metadata; the authorization server (buf.build) offers dynamic client registration, so a harness can sign in without a pre-registered app. The sign-in itself was not completed by this check.
